name: ASM-026 low-profile trackpad assembly benchmark
description: Intermediate hierarchical CAD assembly benchmark for a compact low-profile touch trackpad with slim chassis, glass touch surface, haptic actuator, fasteners, and rubber feet.

tasks.prompt: Create a generic low-profile trackpad assembly with a slim base chassis, glass touch surface, front click zone, internal haptic actuator, side rails, screw posts, and underside rubber feet. Keep the model compact, consumer-electronics recognizable, and robust using simple primitives.
assumptions: This is a generic compact trackpad benchmark and does not model proprietary branding or exact product details.
Repeated fasteners and feet are semantically meaningful assembly occurrences, not excessive decorative detail.
Generated STEP, GLB, topology, and component artifacts are produced by the CAD pipeline and are not hand-edited source of truth.
